items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: That fella named Joe Levy was booking agent. He gave a long syrupy talk... I was the only one who didn't sign a contract.

ctx.x: and they sang it, and that was it. Well, they began packing it in there? Oh yes. Do you have any other big time people from the show that came over there? Oh, it was loaded every night. It got to be,

it got to be an attraction, whereas one performer would ask the other if he heard that band over there. And they'd say, no, it's a go over here. Oh yeah, heavy Berlin and what's the name of these uh, dancers. Oh, it's right on the tip of my tongue right now. They were the big time dancers of all time around that. Man? No, uh, man and his wife. I remember her, Castle, Irene Castle. Uh huh. She used to come in there with a monkey on her shoulder, live monkey. And they danced a couple of times to the music and they…
No. Well, then how come you all left Lambs? Well, how long we had Lambs? Do you remember that?
